correctness.rationale: Arbitrary four distinct 3-subsets are encoded exactly by fifteen membership-type counts satisfying four row sums of three. A 3-subset query center chooses at most three outsiders; scanning q=0..3 is exhaustive for every ambient order. The standalone verifier enumerates exactly 862 feasible vectors, verifies all 16 Boolean traces and the 40 accepted vectors, produces precisely five S4 orbits, and sums their exact labeling weights to (n)_5(6n^2-17n-41)/48 for n>=7, with the n=6 and n<=5 exceptions. Independent direct construction of graph traces agrees exhaustively through n=9. The finite certificate is universal only thanks to the explicit complete cell reduction; it is not an extrapolation.

value.rationale: The maximum-degree coefficient of a VC-shattering polynomial is a natural invariant finer than VC dimension for a canonical family of Johnson graphs. The count unexpectedly reduces to exactly five global hypergraph configurations, undergoes two ambient-size threshold changes at 6 and 7, and implies the nontrivial random shattering probability 3888/n^5+O(n^-6). It informs how maximum-size witnesses are distributed, not merely whether they exist. No new VC bound is claimed.
